name: Amended Taxi Clearance
atcTemplate: {CALLSIGN}, amended taxi instruction, taxi via {ALTERNATIVE_TAXI_ROUTE}, hold short of runway {HOLD_SHORT_RUNWAY}.

name: ATIS Update
source: ATIS acknowledgement practice; local AIP wording should be verified

name: Runway Change Before Line-up
atcTemplate: {CALLSIGN}, runway change, runway {NEW_RUNWAY} now in use, taxi to holding point {NEW_HOLDING_POINT} runway {NEW_RUNWAY} via {NEW_TAXI_ROUTE}.
pilotExpectedTemplate: Taxi to holding point {NEW_HOLDING_POINT} runway {NEW_RUNWAY} via {NEW_TAXI_ROUTE}, {CALLSIGN}.
source: Doc 4444 Ch.12 taxi/runway phraseology; local layout required
constraint: Only select a different runway that exists in the same airport dataset and has a valid route from current position.

name: Traffic Delay / Line Up and Wait
atcTemplate: {CALLSIGN}, runway {RUNWAY}, line up and wait, traffic {TRAFFIC_DESCRIPTION}.

name: Holding Due Traffic
atcTemplate: {CALLSIGN}, hold at {HOLDING_FIX}, maintain {HOLDING_LEVEL}, inbound track {INBOUND_TRACK} degrees, {TURN_DIRECTION}-hand turns, expected approach time {EAT}.
pilotExpectedTemplate: Hold at {HOLDING_FIX}, maintain {HOLDING_LEVEL}, inbound {INBOUND_TRACK}, {TURN_DIRECTION}-hand turns, expected approach time {EAT}, {CALLSIGN}.
source: Holding phraseology/procedure must be tied to AIP chart or instructor-approved lesson record

name: Go-Around Due Runway Occupancy
atcTemplate: {CALLSIGN}, go around, traffic still on runway.
